verified_claims.topic: Excel Header Freezing and Number Formatting
verified_claims.verbatim_quotation: Freeze your header row (View -> Freeze Panes -> Freeze Top Row) so formatting payoff remains visible while scrolling. Select cells with currency data. Go to the Home tab >> select Currency or Accounting from the Number group. Set decimal places to 2.
verified_claims.relevance: Mandates freeze_panes = 'A2' and native currency number_format in openpyxl.

verified_claims.topic: openpyxl Table Uniqueness and Header Constraints
verified_claims.verbatim_quotation: Table names must be unique within a workbook. By default tables are created with a header from the first row and filters for all the columns and table headers and column headings must always contain strings.
verified_claims.relevance: Prevents workbook corruption caused by duplicate or malformed table definitions in openpyxl.
